title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From 24-hour library rooms to quiet corners in the Siena complex, these are the most reliable spots for focused academic work on Bellarmine's campus.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Study Room
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Access this reliable space any time of day for late-night projects. It features computers, a coffee maker, and vending machines for long sessions.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock study environment in the library with essential amenities for extended academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has a 24-hour study room available to students daily, featuring computers, desks, and a coffee maker.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with valid ID.

cards.title: Level 2 Silent Study Space
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Head to the top floor for absolute quiet. Use the whiteboards to map out complex concepts or find a carrel for deep focus.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent zone on the library's second level equipped with whiteboards and individual carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: On Level 2, a large “silent study space” welcomes students to fill whiteboards with notes or type out an essay.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success

cards.title: Merton Center Reading Room
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Study surrounded by the world's largest Merton collection. This scholarly environment is perfect for quiet reading and research.
cards.short_summary: A specialized reading room housing the Thomas Merton archives, offering a quiet and academic atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: In the Center's reading room a complete set of books and journals by and about Merton is available; visitors are welcome to browse and read.
cards.source_title: The Thomas Merton Center at Bellarmine University

cards.title: Knights Knook
cards.subtitle: Centro, Horrigan Hall, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Relax in this renovated lounge featuring comfortable furniture and a fireplace. It is a great spot for casual studying between classes.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, renovated student lounge in Centro with a fireplace and comfortable seating for relaxed study.
cards.evidence_claim: Newly renovated, Knights Knook provides a great location for hanging with friends, relaxing and studying, featuring a fireplace and lounge furniture.
cards.access_notes: Located in Centro; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: The Math Center
cards.subtitle: Centro, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Utilize this quiet space filled with tables and whiteboards. Drop in for free tutoring or work independently on quantitative assignments.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated academic center providing a quiet environment and tutoring resources for math-related studies.
cards.evidence_claim: A quiet space with a multitude of tables, chairs, and whiteboards, this center is perfect for studying.
cards.source_title: 5 Bellarmine Resources Every Student Should Know About
cards.access_notes: Open for drop-in tutoring 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.

cards.title: Allen Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Nolen C. Allen Hall, 3rd & 4th Floors
cards.notes: Find these rooms in the health sciences building for a more secluded atmosphere. They are often available for reservation during finals.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study rooms located in Nolen C. Allen Hall, ideal for students in the health science programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Allen Hall contains study rooms such as ALLN-313, 315, and 316, which can be reserved during final exams.
cards.access_notes: Located at 2120 Newburg Road; building hours apply.

cards.title: Siena Complex Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Siena Primo, Secondo, Terzo & Quarto
cards.notes: Take advantage of the 24-hour study areas within the Siena residence complex. These spots are convenient for residents living on the hill.
cards.short_summary: Resident-accessible study lounges located throughout the Siena housing complex, open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms are located in designated areas in the Siena Complex and are open 24 hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for residents of the Siena complex.

cards.title: Anniversary Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Anniversary Hall, Floors 2-4
cards.notes: Use these floor-specific rooms for group work or solo sessions. They offer a quiet retreat within the traditional residence hall setting.
cards.short_summary: Designated study rooms on the upper floors of Anniversary Hall, providing 24-hour access for residents.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms are located on the second, third and fourth floors of Anniversary Hall and are open 24 hours per day.

cards.title: The Crossover Lounge
cards.subtitle: Between Kennedy and Newman Halls
cards.notes: Study in this unique bridge space connecting two residence halls. It serves as a communal lounge and recreational area for residents.
cards.short_summary: A connecting lounge between Kennedy and Newman Halls that provides space for both recreation and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Kennedy Hall connects with Newman Hall via The Crossover, a lounge and recreational space residents of both buildings can use.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents of Kennedy and Newman Halls.

cards.title: SuRF Center Lobby
cards.subtitle: Sport, Recreation and Fitness Center
cards.notes: Grab a seat in the lobby for a casual study session before or after your workout. It is a high-energy spot for active students.
cards.short_summary: The entrance lobby of the SuRF Center, offering a space for students to gather and study in a fitness-oriented environment.
cards.evidence_claim: The SuRF Center Lobby (SURF-LOB) is listed as a usable room/space on the university events calendar.
cards.source_title: Rooms view - Bellarmine University Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Open during SuRF Center hours (typically until 11 PM on weekdays).
